book_title: Rose has a Right to Happiness
book_topic: Contemporary romance set in the fictional Galway seaside village of Inverbridge, Book 2 of the Inverbridge Series: second chances and two very different men
personalization_detail: Debut Learning to Love Lucy (Oct 2025) was followed six months later by Rose has a Right to Happiness (2026); she began publishing at 61 and sets the series on the Wild Atlantic Way in County Galway.
personalization_reason: Verified on Amazon listings, Swirl and Thread, Self-Pub Fest author page and Buythebook.ie profile (email listed there).
personalized_opening: I was struck that you followed Learning to Love Lucy so quickly with Rose has a Right to Happiness, and that the Inverbridge Series is set on the Wild Atlantic Way in County Galway.
subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Rose has a Right to Happiness
email_body:
Hi Kerry,

I was struck that you followed Learning to Love Lucy so quickly with Rose has a Right to Happiness, and that the Inverbridge Series is set on the Wild Atlantic Way in County Galway.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few reels for Rose has a Right to Happiness is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you like to hear more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Rose has a Right to Happiness best?

Warm regards,
